newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia cuts 1997 total grain harvest estimate.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia cuts 1997 total grain harvest estimate.

text.p: The Slovak Statistics Bureau (SUSR) on Monday cut its estimate for this year's total grain harvest to 3.03 million tonnes down from a previous estimate of 3.12 million tonnes.
SUSR also estimated lower yields for other crops as a result of rains and floods.
According to the latest estimate as of July 15 the per hectare grain yield is put at 4.22 tonnes, 14-percent higher than last year's 3.69 tonnes.
The latest grain harvest estimate puts the overall yield 18 per cent higher than last year, compared to the previous estimate of a 19 percent increase over 1996.
"The estimate for the grain and rapeseed yield has been lowered compared to the previous estimate on June 20 as a result of unfavourable weather," SUSR said.
"The constant rains have delayed the harvest, caused a spread of fungal diseases and lowered the quality," it added.
The rapeseed harvest estimate was lowered to 195,314 tonnes, down from the previous estimate of 199,000 to 208,000 tonnes, SUSR said.
